facts.fact_text: As a result of being declared unconstitutional by the Bulgarian Constitutional Court, UMO Ilinden – PIRIN was dissolved.
In a judgment of 20 October 2005, the Court (European Court of Human Rights) found that the dissolution of UMO Ilinden – PIRIN had been in breach of the party's right to freedom of association.
